description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure Redis as a grain storage provider in Orleans. It provides methods to add Redis storage as default or named storage, with options for configuration.

classes.name: RedisGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to configure Redis as a grain storage provider in Orleans.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures Redis as the default grain storage provider using provided options.

methods.name: AddRedisGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures Redis as a named grain storage provider with specific options.
